---
title: "Figure 6: population-genomic heterogeneity"
format: html
editor: source
---

Presentation-only rebuild of the frozen five-MAG population figure. No new
pair filtering, cluster assignment, distance calculation or statistical fitting.

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(data.table);library(ggplot2);library(grid)})
out<-commandArgs(TRUE)[1];stopifnot(!dir.exists(out))
root<-"/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569/derived"
old<-file.path(root,"population_figure_publication_2026-09-09-v2/tables")
paths<-c(clusters=file.path(old,"population_genomics_cluster_panel.tsv"),
 summary=file.path(old,"population_genomics_summary_panel.tsv"),
 matrix=file.path(old,"population_genomics_propionicimonas_panel.tsv"),
 colours=file.path(root,"figure1_shared_taxonomy_2026-09-14-v3/tables/MAG_colour_alignment.tsv"))
hash<-function(p)digest::digest(file=p,algo="sha256");before<-vapply(paths,hash,character(1))
cl<-fread(paths['clusters']);su<-fread(paths['summary']);ma<-fread(paths['matrix']);co<-fread(paths['colours'])
stopifnot(nrow(su)==5,sum(su$valid_pairs)==139,nrow(cl)==60,nrow(ma)==64)
ids<-c("TI3_MAGScoT_cleanbin_000001","CBF3_MAGScoT_cleanbin_000031","TBF2_MAGScoT_cleanbin_000085","CBF2_MAGScoT_cleanbin_000015","TBF3_MAGScoT_cleanbin_000022")
su[,short_id:=sub("_MAGScoT_cleanbin_0*","/",MAG_ID)]
su[,taxon:=fifelse(nzchar(species),species,fifelse(nzchar(genus),genus,paste0("p__",phylum))) ]
su[,display:=paste(taxon,short_id,sep="\n")]
lev<-su[match(ids,MAG_ID),display]
su[,display:=factor(display,levels=rev(lev))]
su[,colour:=co$colour[match(MAG_ID,co$MAG_ID)]];stopifnot(!anyNA(su$colour))
cl[,display:=factor(su$display[match(panel_label,su$panel_label)],levels=rev(lev))]
sample_order<-c(paste("C",c(paste0("I",1:3),paste0("BF",1:3))),paste("P",c(paste0("I",1:3),paste0("BF",1:3))))
sample_display<-function(x)sub("^P ","T ",x)
cl[,sample_label:=factor(sample_label,levels=sample_order)]
cl[,condition:=factor(fifelse(is.na(condition)|condition=="","unavailable",condition),levels=c("control","treatment","unavailable"))]
base<-theme_classic(base_size=7)+theme(axis.text=element_text(size=7),axis.title=element_text(size=7),
 legend.title=element_text(size=7),legend.text=element_text(size=7),plot.margin=margin(5,6,5,5))
A<-ggplot(cl,aes(sample_label,display))+geom_tile(aes(fill=condition),colour="white",linewidth=.4)+
 geom_text(aes(label=strain_cluster),size=7/ggplot2::.pt,na.rm=TRUE)+
 scale_fill_manual(values=c(control="#8FCB8A",treatment="#7E57C2",unavailable="#ECECEC"),labels=c(control="Control",treatment="Treatment",unavailable="Unavailable"),name=NULL)+
 scale_x_discrete(labels=sample_display)+labs(x=NULL,y=NULL,
 subtitle="S1–S3: strain clusters within each MAG; labels are not shared across MAGs")+base+
 theme(axis.ticks=element_blank(),axis.line=element_blank(),legend.position="bottom")
B<-ggplot(su,aes(median_consensus_differences_per_mbp,display))+
 geom_errorbar(aes(xmin=minimum_consensus_differences_per_mbp,xmax=maximum_consensus_differences_per_mbp,colour=colour),orientation="y",width=.15,linewidth=.5)+
 geom_point(aes(size=observed_samples,fill=colour),shape=21,stroke=.4)+scale_colour_identity()+scale_fill_identity()+
 scale_size_continuous(range=c(2,3.5),breaks=c(6,8,10),name="Observed samples")+
 scale_x_log10(breaks=c(3,10,30,100,300,1000,3000))+
 labs(x="Consensus differences per callable Mbp",y=NULL)+base+theme(legend.position="bottom")
samples<-sample_order[sample_order%in%ma$sample_x]
ma[,sample_x:=factor(sample_x,levels=samples)];ma[,sample_y:=factor(sample_y,levels=rev(samples))]
C<-ggplot(ma,aes(sample_x,sample_y))+geom_tile(aes(fill=consensus_differences_per_mbp),colour="white",linewidth=.3)+
 geom_tile(data=ma[diagonal==TRUE],fill="white",colour="#BDBDBD",linewidth=.3)+
 scale_fill_gradientn(colours=c("#F7FBFF","#9ECAE1","#4292C6","#084594"),trans="log10",na.value="#ECECEC",name="Consensus differences\nper callable Mbp")+
 scale_x_discrete(labels=sample_display)+scale_y_discrete(labels=sample_display)+coord_equal()+
 labs(title="Propionicimonas sp023458095 TI3/1",x=NULL,y=NULL)+base+
 theme(axis.ticks=element_blank(),axis.line=element_blank(),plot.title=element_text(size=7),legend.position="right")
dir.create(file.path(out,"figures"),recursive=TRUE);dir.create(file.path(out,"tables"));dir.create(file.path(out,"source"))
draw_figure <- function() {
grid.newpage();draw<-function(p,x,y,w,h)print(p,vp=viewport(x=x,y=y,width=w,height=h),newpage=FALSE)
draw(A,.5,.855,.98,.265);draw(B,.5,.54,.98,.315);draw(C,.50,.19,.94,.35)
for(i in 1:3)grid.text(LETTERS[i],x=.01,y=c(.988,.706,.366)[i],just="left",gp=gpar(fontsize=9,fontface="bold"))
grid.rect(x=.025,y=.017,width=unit(2,"mm"),height=unit(2,"mm"),gp=gpar(fill="#ECECEC",col=NA))
grid.text("Unavailable",x=.041,y=.017,just="left",gp=gpar(fontsize=7))
grid.text("C: Control   T: Treatment   I: Initial   BF: Backflush",x=.65,y=.017,gp=gpar(fontsize=7))
}
pdf(file.path(out,"figures/figure6-population-heterogeneity.pdf"),width=180/25.4,height=240/25.4,useDingbats=FALSE)
draw_figure()
dev.off()
ragg::agg_png(file.path(out,"figures/preview.png"),width=180,height=240,units="mm",res=180,background="white")
draw_figure()
dev.off()
# Preserve original plotted data byte-for-byte alongside presentation-only tables.
for(n in c("clusters","summary","matrix"))file.copy(paths[n],file.path(out,"tables",basename(paths[n])))
fwrite(su,file.path(out,"tables/display_MAG_labels_colours.tsv"),sep="\t")
caption<-c("Figure 6: Population-genomic heterogeneity across cleaning cycles.",
 "A) Archived inStrain strain-cluster assignments for five MAGs across control and treatment samples. S1–S3 identify clusters within each MAG; the same label in different MAGs does not denote a shared strain. I: initial sampling; BF: backflush sampling; numbers in sample labels denote cleaning cycles. Grey cells indicate unavailable assignments.",
 "B) Median pairwise consensus differences per callable Mbp for each MAG, with whiskers spanning the minimum and maximum across 139 quality-qualified sample pairs. Point size represents the number of observed samples. Taxonomic colours follow the shared community-figure palette.",
 "C) Pairwise consensus differences for Propionicimonas sp023458095 TI3/1. The colour scale is logarithmic; grey cells indicate unavailable or non-qualifying pairs and white diagonal cells denote self-comparisons. Distances and archived cluster assignments were obtained with inStrain (Olm et al., 2021; doi:10.1038/s41587-020-00797-0).",
 "Eligible pairs shared at least 1 Mbp and 50% of the reference MAG; MAGs had at least ten qualifying pairs and six observed samples.")
writeLines(caption,file.path(out,"FIGURE_CAPTION.txt"))
file.copy(Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_NOTEBOOK_PATH"),file.path(out,"source/figure4_population_heterogeneity.qmd"))
stopifnot(identical(before,vapply(paths,hash,character(1))))
fwrite(data.table(path=paths,sha256=before),file.path(out,"input_sha256.tsv"),sep="\t")
files<-list.files(out,recursive=TRUE,full.names=TRUE)
fwrite(data.table(path=substring(files,nchar(out)+2),sha256=vapply(files,hash,character(1))),file.path(out,"output_sha256.tsv"),sep="\t")
cat("PASS: five MAGs; 139 pairs; original tables preserved; shared colours; no refits\n")
```
